use_keycode_enum: use the KeyCode IntEnum to reference USB HID keyboard key codes like KeyCode.W or KeyCode.SPACE
use_mousebutton_enum: use the MouseButton IntEnum to reference mouse buttons like MouseButton.LEFT or MouseButton.RIGHT
check_keycode_membership: check if an integer is a valid KeyCode using the in operator with KeyCodeMetaEnum
convert_magnum_key: call MagnumKeyConverter.convert_key to translate a Magnum GLFW Application.Key to a KeyCode enum value
convert_magnum_mouse_button: call MagnumKeyConverter.convert_mouse_button to translate a Magnum GLFW Application.Pointer to a MouseButton enum value
